findings.title: Foreign self-grant / project takeover
findings.baseEvidence: User A called grant_project_access on User B's project and self-granted admin (F001_A_now_has_acl=true, A view allowed with permission=admin). Base establishes no owner ACL row at creation so the removed first_owner_claim bootstrap accepted any self-grant.
findings.repairEvidence: A self-grant -> HTTP 403 'Project access administration is not available.'; A has no ACL; A view denied. grant_project_access now calls assert_can_manage (owner/admin only) before any write; the first_owner_claim bootstrap is removed; creation bootstraps the owner ACL via an internal, unexposed hook.

findings.title: Unauthorized ACL / membership visibility
findings.baseEvidence: Base list_project_access(project_id) takes no user and performs no authorization; it returns ACL rows to any caller and distinguishes an existing project (rows) from an unknown one (empty) — an existence oracle.
findings.repairEvidence: list_project_access(project_id, user) now calls assert_can_manage first -> HTTP 403 for a foreign caller; an unknown project also returns 403 (nondisclosure consistent). Non-owner describe_access returns only the caller's own effective permission (ownerUserId=None, no membership list).

findings.title: Create/update TOCTOU race (project takeover via PUT)
findings.baseEvidence: Deterministic barrier interleaving: A passes _authorize_project(allow_missing=True) while the project is absent, B creates+commits it, A resumes and upsert overwrites -> final DB state created_by=B, updated_by=A, name='A-HIJACKED' (TAKEOVER=true).
findings.repairEvidence: Authorization now happens inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE _project_acl_transaction; update_locked carries an owner/created_by identity guard in its WHERE clause; create() is a plain INSERT (409 on conflict). 25 genuine concurrent rounds -> 0 takeovers; A denied (403/409) in all 13 rounds where B won the create; 10 same-ID rounds -> exactly one winner, one owner membership, loser update denied 10/10.

findings.title: Audit event split across databases / non-atomic authorization
findings.repairEvidence: Project mutation audit is written in the same transaction as the project/ACL rows. Injecting an audit-persistence failure during create_project rolled back the whole transaction: no project row, no ACL rows (ROLLBACK_CLEAN=true).

findings.title: Stage 3 project-route scope (data-reader reachability)
findings.repairEvidence: All active project-bearing Stage 3 routes are project-scoped: persistence_router 73/73 path routes guarded (require_project_view/edit); cockpit router 38 active routes guarded (require_legacy_research_project -> require_project_view + Gen-2 binding, or require_project_view/edit + authorize_modeling_scope), 9 retired routes return HTTP 410. The scope primitive enforces owner->allow, foreign->403, anon->403, viewer-cannot-edit->403, missing->404, blank->400.

findings.title: Wave 2 prior authority resolved from the disposable worktree (cwd-relative root)
findings.repairEvidence: resolve_project_fit_bundle no longer defaults root to the cwd-relative DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_ROOT; it defaults to runtime_prior_root() (governed ASP_MODEL_STUDIO_RUNTIME_ROOT/ASP_MLB_PLAYER_PRIOR_V2_ROOT, else <repo>/.runtime). The canonical root in the primary .runtime resolves the asp-mtlozhdx fit bundle bac2d184 whose authorityId is 9d9cfaf3, self-contained (9 objects, all content-addressed), without referencing .tmp/asp-player-prior-wave2.

findings.title: Downstream Stage 3 hard-bound to pilot project asp-mtddc6pw
findings.repairEvidence: Base hard-coded EXPECTED_PROJECT_ID/asp-mtddc6pw in stage3_executable_artifact.py (3), stage3_game_scoring.py (2), stage3_model_laboratory.py (2). Repair server source contains zero hard-coded pilot-id occurrences; downstream resolves the active project's authorities.

scopeExpansion: none beyond the six declared repair areas; the 8-commit delta touches only tenant security, project write atomicity, Stage 3 route scope, Wave 2 canonical publication, downstream project binding, and tests/evidence. Prior estimator math and content-addressed science identities are unchanged; no runtime object, receipt, or manifest was rewritten; no deletions/renames.

verificationMutations.note: All dynamic and concurrency testing used disposable SQLite databases, synthetic users/projects, and temporary runtime roots under the scratch directory. The primary authoritative database and canonical runtime objects were opened read-only only for snapshots.
